limitations: One run per configuration; not a statistical attribution of latency causes.
Same physical host; disjoint logical CPU sets share memory and networking. Other host workloads are not isolated.
Local Caddy mirrors documented API routing, without production TLS, HTTP/2, WAN, media or provider traffic.
SSE bytes count received response bodies, not HTTP/TCP/TLS overhead; average rates hide snapshot/reconnect bursts.
90-second phases have 30 commands, 100 initial shots, and reconnect halfway. Later phases have longer timelines. Not comparable as a regression to previous 180-second shared-CPU runs.
The generator remains a possible bottleneck; its event-loop lag at 10000 viewers is 63-83 ms p95.

HTTP percentiles cover successful residual fetches, with different sample populations. Published delivery excludes write/preparation/bootstrap time. Final harness audit checks notification/live revisions rather than every public payload.
